# 软件与版本

```{r versions}
si <- sessionInfo()
pk <- c("ggplot2", "dplyr")
ver <- sapply(pk, function(x) tryCatch(as.character(packageVersion(x)), error = function(e) "未安装"))
kable(data.frame(软件 = c("R", names(ver)),
                 版本 = c(paste(si$R.version$major, si$R.version$minor, sep = "."), unname(ver))),
      caption = "软件与依赖版本")
```
